name: Stupid Wife
description: Luíza and Valentina are law students and classmates, but from totally different worlds and personalities. Luiza sees in Valentina all the flaws she believes someone can have, and hates her. One day, however, Luiza wakes up to find herself ten years older and, to her horror, married to Valentina. It turns out that now, Luíza was the victim of a trauma, which she is still unaware of and which led her to a process of Dissociative Amnesia; not remembering her marriage to Valentina, much less her son Leo. In this process, she will need to rediscover herself, who she has become. At the same time, Valentina seeks to win back her wife.

videos.title: Christmas Special - Episode 1
videos.overview: In October 2021, months before Luiza's memory loss, Léo makes a naive request that deeply affects Valentina; and the day that was supposed to be a family one ends up in a painful argument between Catarina and her daughter.

videos.title: Christmas Special - Episode 2
videos.overview: In December 2021, Valentina tries to control her frustration at not being able to present Leo with her request, while the others prepare to celebrate Christmas.

videos.title: Christmas Special - Episode 3
videos.overview: The love between Luíza and Valentina is so strong that it is almost palpable, and, together with the Christmas spirit, this becomes even more evident. However, Christmas for both may not be as expected.

videos.title: Christmas Special - Episode 4
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, Valentina and her mother call a truce, putting aside their differences, while everyone has fun at the dinner table. And after a hidden friend full of laughter, Luíza tells Valentina that she is pregnant.

videos.title: College Special - Episode 1
videos.overview: Like a real trip back in time, in this special, we go back ten years in the past to delve into the love story of Luiza and Valentina, seeing how it all began.

videos.title: College Special - Episode 2
videos.overview: As the semester goes by, Valentina's implications for Luiza become more and more constant. However, after a rainy night where both are trapped in the college bathroom, anger turns to foster care.

videos.title: College Special - Episode 3
videos.overview: After a night of fun and games, Valentina changes tactics and tries to win over Luiza in a sweeter way. And in a small argument that took place in the garden, they kiss for the first time.

videos.title: College Special - Episode 4
videos.overview: Luiza finally realizes that she is in love with Valentina, and they both embark on a beautiful love story. However, in the future, Valentina faces her mother and their fraternal bonds are broken.

videos.title: The Awakening
videos.overview: In 2012, Luiza faithfully claims to hate Valentina. However, when she wakes up on a seemingly ordinary morning, she finds herself in an unfamiliar room and then discovers that she has forgotten ten years of her life. And the worst? She is married to Valentina.

videos.title: Memories
videos.overview: Valentina tries to deal with the fact that Luíza doesn't remember her and Léo, while Luíza finds a box with small memories from the past. "If the person is destined for you regardless of everything, you will find each other, even if you need to recognize each other a thousand times."

videos.title: Restart
videos.overview: In the midst of the troubled relationship that both now share, Valentina gradually seeks to regain Luísa's trust and love, while she becomes more flexible about her present.

videos.title: Scars
videos.overview: After a family dinner that apparently should be relaxed in order to smooth things over, Luíza exaggerates in drinking and ends up offending Valentina.

videos.title: Shelter
videos.overview: After a family day, Luíza tries to fix things after feeling remorse for the harsh words she poured out on Valentina, as she fears a divorce.

videos.title: Desire
videos.overview: After deciding to give their relationship a second chance, things finally seem to be coming together, except for Luiza's desperate dream.

videos.title: Shadows
videos.overview: With the recent emotions experienced, Luíza discovers that in addition to dissociativo amnesia, her clinical condition has evolved into despersonalização crises, making Valentina reflect on past events.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: Luíza finds herself increasingly enchanted by Valentina and the beautiful family they both built together, but memories of the past arise to torment the calm of their lives.

videos.title: Silence
videos.overview: When it seemed that things were finally getting back on track, fate shows us that there are still many more layers to be revealed in Luiza and Valentina's relationship.

videos.title: consequence
videos.overview: Luiza begins to understand that the pain and anguish she felt were related to the loss of the baby. Meanwhile, Valentina tells a little about how they started to relate in the past with the aim of easing Luiza's suffering.

videos.title: Revelation
videos.overview: Between family moments, games and lots of fun, Valentina comes across a letter that Luiza wrote years ago, shortly after Leo's birth.

videos.title: Connection
videos.overview: The days of the Campos Albuquerque family are getting more and more fun. However, while Luiza and Valentina's relationship grows stronger, Duda and Igor find themselves in different tunes.

videos.title: Transformation
videos.overview: Little flashes of the past show how Luiza surrendered to Valentina's charms. While in the present, Duda vents about her relationship with Igor and exposes his fear of postpartum depression.

videos.title: Construction
videos.overview: After a walk filled with conversations and complicity, Luiza says "I love you" for the first time to Valentina after losing her memory.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: The mother-daughter relationship between Catarina and Valentina becomes increasingly distant; meanwhile, Luiza and Valentina find themselves falling more and more in love.

videos.title: Control
videos.overview: Marcos is teaching Leo to plant, just like he used to do with Valentina when she was younger. Meanwhile, Luiza finds out that Leo's donor is Igor and goes to ask Valentina.

videos.title: Defense
videos.overview: Luíza and Valentina despair when they discover that Catarina has filed a lawsuit to be entitled to custody of Léo, leaving the structures of the Campos Albuquerque family shaken.

videos.title: Impotence
videos.overview: Valentina is in a state of complete anguish due to the recent events involving Leo's custody and Luiza tries at all costs to support her.
